message.subject: Differentiating in the overlaminate space
message.body:
Hi [Name],

I've been following Grimco's presence at ISA and Printing United—impressive how you've maintained that FASTSIGNS recognition year after year.

I'm reaching out because we're seeing distributors like Grimco look for ways to differentiate beyond the standard 3M/Avery portfolio, especially when fabricators are comparing primarily on price. Our PVF overlaminate has been helping sales teams win architectural and transit projects where standard films don't meet the performance specs clients are demanding.

Would it be worth a brief conversation to explore whether there's a fit? Happy to share how similar distributors are positioning it with their field teams.

Best,
[Your name]

personalization_used.hook: Grimco's sales teams compete against distributors with similar portfolios, creating pressure to differentiate beyond price
personalization_used.value_prop_emphasized: Competitive differentiation and sales enablement for premium architectural/transit segments
